tagline: Health information and professional decision support. Not a replacement for a doctor or pharmacist.

common.name: Name
common.disclaimer: This information supports — but does not replace — professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

home.title: Clinical Decision Support
home.intro: Describe symptoms in everyday language. The system organizes information, asks follow-up questions, and retrieves approved medical sources. Final diagnosis and prescribing stay with qualified professionals.
home.disclaimer: This application does not diagnose conditions or independently prescribe medication.
home.howSub: Three steps, with a qualified professional in the loop at every stage.

describe.title: Describe in your own words
describe.body: Tell the assistant what you are feeling. Add allergies and current medication if relevant.

organize.title: AI organizes and retrieves
organize.body: Symptoms are extracted, follow-up questions are asked, and evidence is pulled only from approved sources such as WHO, Rwanda MoH, and Rwanda FDA.

decide.title: Professionals decide
decide.body: Doctors and pharmacists review the assessment, add their clinical judgement, and remain responsible for diagnosis and treatment.

home.rolesSub: Each role gets a focused workspace with the right information and the right limits.

patient.title: Patient
patient.body: Understand your symptoms before you consult.
patient.bullet2: See possible conditions, warning signs, and urgency
patient.bullet3: Review your consultation history and sources

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.body: Structured decision support, not automated diagnosis.
doctor.bullet1: Review patient history and AI assessments
doctor.bullet2: Accept, modify, or reject AI suggestions
doctor.bullet3: Add diagnosis, clinical notes, and treatment plans

pharmacist.title: Pharmacist
pharmacist.body: Medication safety checks at the point of dispensing.

safety.title: Medical safety first
safety.body: The assistant never claims certainty, never presents itself as a doctor, and never tells you to stop or change medication on its own. In an emergency, contact your local emergency services immediately.

aiAssistant.title: AI Assistant
aiAssistant.subtitle: Clinical decision support grounded in approved sources. Final judgment stays with you.
aiAssistant.greeting: Ask me anything clinical: differentials, medication guidance, interactions, or what the approved sources say about a case. I cite what I retrieve — you make the call.
aiAssistant.inputPlaceholder: e.g. Differential for fever and headache after travel to a malaria zone
aiAssistant.suggestion1: What does the guidance say about managing uncomplicated malaria?
aiAssistant.suggestion2: Interaction risk of metronidazole with warfarin?
aiAssistant.suggestion3: Red flags I should not miss in a child with fever?
aiAssistant.contextSub: Optional patient summary or medication list sent with each question.
aiAssistant.contextPlaceholder: e.g. 34-year-old, 22 weeks pregnant, on iron supplements, reports fever for 3 days
aiAssistant.detailsSub: Latest structured output from the approved sources.
aiAssistant.missingInfo: Information that would refine the answer
aiAssistant.emptyReply: The assistant returned no text for this question.
aiAssistant.failed: I could not complete that request. Please try again in a moment.
